settings.heading: Questions, answered
settings.text: How ordering, pickup, delivery and the meals themselves work. Still stuck? Call or text and we will help.

settings.q: When do I need to order by?
settings.a: Thursday at 6 PM for meals the following Tuesday. The bar at the top of the site always shows the next cut-off and how long is left.

settings.q: When does the new menu go up?
settings.a: Every week. A short menu of new meals and returning favourites goes up at the start of the week.
Add meals from this week’s menu, pick your base where there is a choice, and check out. Pickup and delivery options appear at checkout.

settings.q: Can I add a note to my order?
settings.a: Yes. Open your cart and use “Order special instructions”, or call or text (317) 294-2433.
Now and then. When we do, the site says so at the top and the menu is paused until the next week.
At the cooler in Ironsmith’s Gym, 1714 E Main St, Crawfordsville, on Tuesday.
Yes, to your door on Tuesday. The delivery options for your address, and any fee, show at checkout.
No. Everything is chef-prepared with fresh, never-frozen ingredients.

settings.q: How do I heat a meal?
settings.a: Keep meals refrigerated. Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes and enjoy.

settings.q: Where can I see calories and protein?
settings.a: Each meal page shows its macros and nutrition label when we have one. You can also try the macro calculator to find your daily targets.

settings.q: I have an allergy. Can I still order?
settings.a: Please call or text us before you order at (317) 294-2433 and we will tell you what is in each meal.
Yes: company dinners, work lunches, rehearsal dinners and weddings. Start a catering inquiry.
Every event is different, so we quote each one. Send your date, headcount and what you have in mind.
